tools.name: code_read
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file (up to 1 MB). With offset (1-based line) and/or limit (default 2000 lines) the result has numbered lines and says where to continue. A file must be read before code_edit can change it.

tools.name: code_edit
tools.description: Replace exact text in a file you have read with code_read. Fails if old_string is not found, or matches more than once unless replace_all is true. Keep indentation exactly as in the file; never include the line-number prefix. The old file is copied to .agent-undo/ first.

tools.name: code_glob
tools.description: Find files by name pattern (for example **/*.rs) below a directory. Respects .gitignore. Newest first, at most 100.

tools.name: code_grep
tools.description: Search file contents with a regular expression in a directory or one file. include filters file names, for example *.py or *.{ts,tsx}. Respects .gitignore. At most 100 matches.

tools.name: code_tree
tools.description: Show the files and directories below a directory as an indented tree (default depth 3, at most 500 entries). Respects .gitignore.
